content.reasoning: There are no comparable sales on the platform yet, so this band comes only from your 50 to 85 percent policy and general clearance rules, not from demand we have seen. Grade A condition and a balanced S to XL spread favour you, but stitched embroidered lawn is a fashion piece tied to this summer, and a 500-piece lot narrows the buyer pool. The lot has sat for 45 days at 70 percent off, so holding near that level or going a little deeper, toward the upper 70s, is reasonable, especially as the summer selling window closes. Splitting into two smaller lots could also widen the buyer pool without cutting the discount further.
